newsitem.title: SPAIN: VOLKSWAGEN'S SEAT JAN-JULY CAR SALES UP 11 PCT.
newsitem.headline: VOLKSWAGEN'S SEAT JAN-JULY CAR SALES UP 11 PCT.

text.p: Volkswagen AG's Spanish unit Seat said on Friday sales in the seven months to end-July rose 11 percent to a record 237,840 units.
It said exports in July rose 13 percent to 23,939 units.
SEAT said it expects to sell more than 400,000 units in 1997.
Sales in July alone rose 15 percent to 39,351 units.
Of total exports in July, those to Italy rose 81 percent, Sweden was up 86 percent, and exports to Germany rose 29 percent.
Spanish sales rose 22 percent to 15,808 units in July, of which 8,045 units were the Ibiza model.
